stewardship.deescalation: Not applicable to antibiotics. Complete the full antimalarial course for both species (ACT for the falciparum component, chloroquine/ACT plus primaquine radical cure for the vivax component per G6PD status and national guidelines).
framework: Treat as P. falciparum malaria first and foremost (artemisinin-based combination therapy) given its disproportionate severe-disease risk, while also addressing P. vivax with the appropriate radical cure regimen.

G6PD testing should be performed before primaquine administration (needed for P. vivax radical cure) given the hemolysis risk in G6PD-deficient patients — this is a mandatory safety step, not optional.
Monitor closely for severity criteria given the P. falciparum component — mixed infections should be managed with at least the same vigilance as pure falciparum malaria.
This is not an antibiotic stewardship scenario in the traditional sense — no antibacterial agents are indicated; the key decision is comprehensive antimalarial species coverage.

references: National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP) India Guidelines

decision.label: Urgent antimalarial therapy required (NOT an antibiotic)
